674	func bootstrapPrimaryFromCheckpointRemote(ctx context.Context, repo *git.Repository, primary plumbing.ReferenceName) bool {

678			// and a slow/unreachable checkpoint remote must not stall every turn.
679			// Fall back to the empty orphan, which self-heals immediately.

682		}

686			// diverging from the real v1 branch. Under the git-refs primary backend

688			// nothing is ever written to v1, so there is no divergence to prevent and
689			// the fetch buys nothing at enable time.

694			// checkpoints stay readable — the read paths fetch v1 from the checkpoint
695			// remote when a read actually needs it, and fetch individual blobs by
696			// hash rather than the whole branch.

701		worktreeRoot, err := getRepoPath(repo)
702		if err != nil {
703			logging.Debug(ctx, "checkpoint-remote: cannot resolve worktree root for enable bootstrap",

194	// fetchMetadataBranchIfMissing fetches the primary metadata ref from a URL only if it doesn't exist locally.
195	// This avoids network calls on every push — once the branch exists locally, this is a no-op.
196	// It runs on the push hot path, so it uses the short fetch budget.
197	//
198	// A fetch failure is not fatal — the push will create the branch on the remote
199	// when it succeeds — but it is returned rather than swallowed so the caller can
200	// log it. Returning nil unconditionally meant a checkpoint remote that was
201	// unreachable, too slow, or refusing auth looked identical to one that was never
202	// contacted, and resolvePushSettings' warning could never fire.
203	//
204	// A remote that simply does not carry the branch yet (the normal state of a
205	// brand-new checkpoint repo) is not a failure and stays quiet. That case is
206	// established by probing with ls-remote first — positive evidence, matching
207	// remote.FetchCheckpointRef's absence-vs-failure contract — rather than by
208	// treating every fetch error as absence.
209	func fetchMetadataBranchIfMissing(ctx context.Context, remoteURL string) error {
210		repo, err := OpenRepository(ctx)
211		if err != nil {
212			return fmt.Errorf("failed to open repository: %w", err)
213		}
214		defer repo.Close()
215	
216		// Check if branch already exists locally - if so, nothing to do
217		refs := checkpoint.ResolveRefs(ctx)
218		if _, err := repo.Reference(refs.Primary, true); err == nil {
219			return nil // Branch exists locally, skip fetch
220		}
221	
222		probeCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, checkpointRemoteFetchTimeout)
223		defer cancel()
224		out, probeErr := remote.LsRemoteInDir(probeCtx, "", remoteURL, refs.Primary.String())
225		if probeErr != nil {
226			return fmt.Errorf("probe %s on %s: %w", refs.Primary, remote.RedactURL(remoteURL), probeErr)
227		}
228		if len(bytes.TrimSpace(out)) == 0 {
229			// Remote reachable, branch not there yet. The first push creates it.
230			return nil
